import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source6_58_0 and Source6_58_1 on SEQN
df_0_1 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Operation 2: JOIN Source6_58_4 and Source6_58_3 on SEQN
df_4_3 = pd.merge(source4, source3, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Operation 3: JOIN Source6_58_5 and Source6_58_7 on SEQN
df_5_7 = pd.merge(source5, source7, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Operation 4: JOIN Source6_58_0 and Source6_58_2 on SEQN
df_0_2 = pd.merge(source0, source2, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Now we have these intermediate joined tables:
# df_0_1 (from Source0 and Source1)
# df_4_3 (from Source4 and Source3)
# df_5_7 (from Source5 and Source7)
# df_0_2 (from Source0 and Source2)

# The group_by is on Source6_58_0.SEQN, so SEQN is the key for grouping.

# To aggregate, we need to join all relevant data on SEQN to have all columns accessible.
# We have overlaps in source0 in df_0_1 and df_0_2, so we must be careful to avoid duplication.
# The aggregation references columns from:
# - source0: Albumin(ug/mL), creatinine(mg/dL)
# - source1: glycohemoglobin
# - source2: total_cholesterol(mg/dL)
# - source3: 60_sec_pulse, systolic, diastolic
# - source4: weight_kg, standing_height, waist_circumference, arm_circumference
# - source5: hepatitis_A
# - source7: calcium(mg/dL), iron(ug/dL), potassium(mmol/L), sodium(mmol/L), phosphorus(mg/dL), total_protein(g/dL), triglycerides(mg/dL)
# - source6: 9 mental health related columns (sum aggregation)

# We must join all these sources on SEQN to have a single dataframe for aggregation.

# Start by merging df_0_1 and df_0_2 on SEQN to combine source0, source1, and source2 data.
# Both df_0_1 and df_0_2 contain source0 columns, so to avoid duplication, drop source0 columns from df_0_2 except SEQN before merging.
df_0_2_drop = df_0_2.drop(columns=["Albumin(ug/mL)", "creatinine(mg/dL)"])
df_0_1_2 = pd.merge(df_0_1, df_0_2_drop, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Now merge df_0_1_2 with df_4_3 (source4 and source3)
df_0_1_2_4_3 = pd.merge(df_0_1_2, df_4_3, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Merge the above with df_5_7 (source5 and source7)
df_merged = pd.merge(df_0_1_2_4_3, df_5_7, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Finally, merge with source6 (mental health data)
df_all = pd.merge(df_merged, source6, on="SEQN", how="inner")

# Now perform the group by aggregation on SEQN
agg_dict = {
    "Albumin(ug/mL)": "mean",
    "creatinine(mg/dL)": "mean",
    "glycohemoglobin": "mean",
    "total_cholesterol(mg/dL)": "mean",
    "60_sec_pulse": "mean",
    "systolic": "mean",
    "diastolic": "mean",
    "weight_kg": "mean",
    "standing_height": "mean",
    "waist_circumference": "mean",
    "arm_circumference": "mean",
    "hepatitis_A": "mean",
    "calcium(mg/dL)": "mean",
    "iron(ug/dL)": "mean",
    "potassium(mmol/L)": "mean",
    "sodium(mmol/L)": "mean",
    "phosphorus(mg/dL)": "mean",
    "total_protein(g/dL)": "mean",
    "triglycerides(mg/dL)": "mean",
    "Have little interest in doing things": "sum",
    "Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless": "sum",
    "Trouble sleeping or sleeping too much": "sum",
    "Feeling tired or having little energy": "sum",
    "Poor appetite or overeating": "sum",
    "Feeling bad about yourself": "sum",
    "Trouble concentrating on things": "sum",
    "Moving or speaking slowly or too fast": "sum",
    "Thought you would be better off dead": "sum",
}

df_grouped = df_all.groupby("SEQN", as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# According to target schema, some columns are integer type (mental health sums), others float.
# Convert mental health columns to integer explicitly
mental_health_cols = [
    "Have little interest in doing things",
    "Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless",
    "Trouble sleeping or sleeping too much",
    "Feeling tired or having little energy",
    "Poor appetite or overeating",
    "Feeling bad about yourself",
    "Trouble concentrating on things",
    "Moving or speaking slowly or too fast",
    "Thought you would be better off dead",
]

df_grouped[mental_health_cols] = df_grouped[mental_health_cols].astype(int)

# Ensure SEQN is integer
df_grouped["SEQN"] = df_grouped["SEQN"].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "SEQN",
    "weight_kg",
    "standing_height",
    "waist_circumference",
    "arm_circumference",
    "60_sec_pulse",
    "systolic",
    "diastolic",
    "Albumin(ug/mL)",
    "creatinine(mg/dL)",
    "total_cholesterol(mg/dL)",
    "glycohemoglobin",
    "hepatitis_A",
    "calcium(mg/dL)",
    "iron(ug/dL)",
    "potassium(mmol/L)",
    "sodium(mmol/L)",
    "phosphorus(mg/dL)",
    "total_protein(g/dL)",
    "triglycerides(mg/dL)",
    "Have little interest in doing things",
    "Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless",
    "Trouble sleeping or sleeping too much",
    "Feeling tired or having little energy",
    "Poor appetite or overeating",
    "Feeling bad about yourself",
    "Trouble concentrating on things",
    "Moving or speaking slowly or too fast",
    "Thought you would be better off dead",
]

df_final = df_grouped[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified path
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_58/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
